description: Returns playlist segments with timing and media pointers (progressive MP4/M4A URLs, typically ~7 days). sample-* ids return a curated sample playlist (no auth, no live media URLs). Connected org ids use the Content API when the team has API entitlement. Use when the user wants to see the segment structure or how to play a workout.

browse_tool.description: Widget hint: the list the card's "Browse" button reopens, e.g. "list_team_workouts". Does not change the data.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

workout_id.description: Workout ID: a sample-* ID from list_sample_workouts, or a team workout ID from list_team_workouts.

name: get_workout_playlist
title: Get workout playlist
